title: Graphics entry reference release
summary: Recover VA 0x49ca20 thiscall release(bool): honor ownership unless forced, locate reference base through vbtable[1], drain unsigned counts when forced, call scalar deleting destructor slot zero with flag 1 at zero, clear resource and return whether empty. Original instructions and three direct call sites inspected.
test_description: Differential original-address oracle tests with initialized FS and restoration checks: null/present resources, four ownership values, both force settings, positive/negative virtual-base displacements, counts 0/1/2/3/17/257 and high unsigned counts for ordinary release. Verify return, counter underflow/drain, destructor this/flag/count/entry visibility, destructor mutations, cleared pointer, untouched fields and complete fixture byte equality.
known_limits: Class identities, full vtables and ownership field meaning beyond its zero/nonzero test remain unknown; layouts model only observed fields of the original 32-bit ABI.
Controlled callbacks validate invocation semantics, not real rendering resource destruction, allocation or exception behavior.
Forced release with huge positive counts is not executed due to its linear iteration cost; ordinary release covers high-bit counts and zero underflow.
Invalid pointers, malformed vbtables, concurrent counter mutation and destructor exceptions are outside the valid normal-path test domain. No thread-safety is implied.
Readable behavior recovery only; no compiler-built matching-byte credit is claimed.
